aboutPage.title: About Secret Scroll
aboutPage.subtitle: Uncover secrets, share truths.
aboutPage.p1: Secret Scroll is a platform for anonymous expression. We believe in the power of sharing stories, thoughts, and confessions without the fear of judgment. Our community is built on trust, respect, and the shared human experience.
aboutPage.p2: Whether you have a funny anecdote, a deep reflection, a random thought, or need some advice, this is your space to share it with the world, protected by anonymity.
aboutPage.p3: Our mission is to create a safe and open environment where every voice can be heard. You can access Secret Scroll on web or download our official Android app for a seamless mobile experience.

copyrightPage.title: Copyright Policy
copyrightPage.subtitle: Respecting intellectual property.
copyrightPage.p1: Secret Scroll respects the intellectual property rights of others and expects its users to do the same. It is our policy, in appropriate circumstances and at our discretion, to disable and/or terminate the accounts of users who repeatedly infringe the copyrights or other intellectual property rights of others.
copyrightPage.p2: If you are a copyright owner, or are authorized to act on behalf of one, or authorized to act under any exclusive right under copyright, please report alleged copyright infringements taking place on or through the Site by completing a DMCA Notice of Alleged Infringement and delivering it to our designated Copyright Agent.
copyrightPage.p3: Upon receipt of the Notice as described below, Secret Scroll will take whatever action, in its sole discretion, it deems appropriate, including removal of the challenged material from the Site.

termsPage.title: Terms of Use
termsPage.subtitle: Please read our terms of use carefully.
termsPage.p1: By accessing or using Secret Scroll, you agree to be bound by these terms of use.
termsPage.p2: You are solely responsible for the content you post. You agree not to post any content that is illegal, defamatory, hateful, or that infringes on any third-party rights, including intellectual property and privacy rights. We are not responsible for any content, including pictures or personal details, that you may find on this platform. The content shared here is not published by us, and we do not endorse it.
termsPage.p3: You agree to use the service responsibly and not to engage in any activity that could harm the service or its users. This includes, but is not limited to, harassment, spamming, and attempting to gain unauthorized access to the system.
termsPage.p4: We may terminate or suspend your access to our service immediately, without prior notice or liability, for any reason whatsoever, including without limitation if you breach the Terms.

patchNotesPage.title: Patch Notes
patchNotesPage.subtitle: See what's new in Secret Scroll.
patchNotesPage.v3_item1: UI Refresh: Introduced a new 'Slate' theme with a vibrant lime accent and a full theme switcher with multiple color options (Purple, Green, Slate).
patchNotesPage.v3_item2: Instagram Reels-Style UI: Implemented a full-screen, vertical swipe feed for mobile users for a modern, immersive experience.
patchNotesPage.v3_item3: Internationalization (i18n): Added full support for English, French, and Arabic, complete with a language switcher in the header.
patchNotesPage.v3_item4: Patch Notes Page: Created this very page to document our development journey and keep you informed of all new features and fixes.
patchNotesPage.v3_item5: Improved Onboarding: Added a disclaimer screen for first-time users that requires explicit agreement before entering the app.
patchNotesPage.v2_item1: Advanced Protected Names: Implemented a powerful fuzzy-matching system to block protected names even if they are reversed or misspelled.
patchNotesPage.v2_item2: Smarter Moderation Flow: Posts with protected names are now immediately rejected, while other flagged content goes to a pending queue for admin review.
patchNotesPage.v2_item3: Granular Admin Permissions: Overhauled the admin system. Super admins can now grant specific permissions (e.g., 'approve_pictures', 'delete_posts') to other admins.
patchNotesPage.v2_item4: Secure Firestore Rules: Iteratively fixed and hardened security rules to prevent permission errors and correctly enforce role-based access.
patchNotesPage.v2_item5: User & Comment Moderation: Admins can now view all users and delete any comment directly from the dashboard or comment sheets.
patchNotesPage.v2_item6: Manual Word Filter: Re-introduced the manual 'Forbidden Words' list alongside the AI checker for more precise control.
patchNotesPage.v1_item1: Core Features: Anonymous and pseudonymous posting, voting, and commenting system.
patchNotesPage.v1_item2: Authentication: Support for both Google Sign-In and unique Anonymous guest accounts.
patchNotesPage.v1_item3: Image Uploads: Integrated Cloudinary for robust image hosting and delivery.
patchNotesPage.v1_item4: Basic Admin Dashboard: Initial tools for content moderation and user management.
patchNotesPage.v4_item1: Flutter Android APK Release: Launched the native Secret Scroll app built with Flutter (1.0.0), offering full feature parity with the web platform on Android devices.
patchNotesPage.v4_item2: Cross-Platform Support: Built with Flutter for smooth performance and native Android integration with Firebase Auth, Cloud Firestore, and Google Sign-In.
patchNotesPage.v4_item3: Download Page: Added a dedicated download page for easy APK access and installation.
